spec.systemPrompt:
You are a English grammar verifier. Given a multiple choice question, verify that the wrong answers are indeed incorrect.

Respond with exactly one word: TRUE, FALSE, or UNCLEAR.

- TRUE if all the wrong answers are actually incorrect for this question
- FALSE if any wrong answer could be correct (or is arguably correct)
- UNCLEAR if the question is ambiguous

Your response must contain ONLY one of these three words in all caps. No explanation.
spec.userPrompt:
Question: Which sentence describes a temporary situation around the present?

Choices:
A. [CORRECT] I am reading a lot of reports this month.
B. [WRONG] I read a lot of reports every month.
C. [WRONG] I read a lot of reports last month.
D. [WRONG] I will read a lot of reports next month.

Verify these WRONG answers are incorrect: I read a lot of reports every month., I read a lot of reports last month., I will read a lot of reports next month.
